blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current five views and six poses: neutral and arms-up still show a pale vertically segmented center strip projecting below the overskirt. Crouch shows exposed avatar thigh and separated angular cloth between the legs; sit shows exposed thigh and collapsed rear skirt panels. Joining the lower front/back rise seams did not yield a clean continuous shorts appearance. Garment coverage, ease, fit, deformation and runtime are unaccepted.

The standing overskirt is broad and irregular rather than clearly pleated. Crouch and sit have curled, separated angular panels behind/between the thighs, and prone collapses into a blocky sheet. Cloth simulation ran, but these poses remain visually rejected.

The high collar remains a tall open cylindrical rim; sleeves and underarm transitions are heavily faceted and wrinkled in neutral, arms-up and arm-cross views. No measured fit, clearance, strain, Shape Key or runtime acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
